product.title: Red Rock Canyon Electric Bike Tour

description.text: Explore the Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area on a guided electric bike tour from Las Vegas. Ride portions of the scenic loop with support from your guide while stopping at overlooks to learn about Mojave Desert geology, wildlife, and conservation.

highlights: Guided electric bike experience through Red Rock Canyon.
Ride scenic sections with desert and canyon viewpoints.
Learn about local geology and Mojave ecology from your guide.

meetingPoint.description: Hotel pickup from select Las Vegas Strip and Downtown locations may be available; exact confirmation is provided by the operator after booking.

itineraryItems.title: Las Vegas pickup and bike setup
itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide, complete safety briefing, and get fitted for your e-bike before departure.

itineraryItems.title: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Drive route
itineraryItems.description: Ride guided segments near the Scenic Drive corridor with regular stops for photos and interpretation.

itineraryItems.title: Overlook and geology stops
itineraryItems.description: Pause at viewpoints to discuss sandstone formations, desert habitat, and conservation area highlights.

additionalInfo: Travelers should have a moderate physical fitness level
Not recommended for travelers with serious mobility limitations
